title: Learn alone
safetyNote: Learning outputs should remain source-based and human-reviewed before public use.

title: Learn with a team
description: For friends, student groups, professional teams, or civic groups.
safetyNote: Teams should assign source review, safeguarding review, and partner review roles.

title: Workshop
safetyNote: Workshops should use reviewed facilitation notes and avoid unsupported claims.

title: Campus action lab
description: For universities, labs, or student groups building responsible projects.
safetyNote: Projects must avoid sensitive data, operational details, and unsupported deployment.

title: Community learning circle
description: For community-based learning, only if partner-mediated and safeguarding-reviewed.
safetyNote: Community learning circles involving crisis-affected people, minors, or vulnerable groups must be partner-mediated, safeguarding-reviewed, and human-approved.

title: Partner project
description: For learning connected to a vetted organization or institutional partner.
safetyNote: Partner projects require clear supervision, accountability, safeguarding, and human approval.

title: Cross-community cohort
description: For learning across communities, only if conflict-sensitive, partner-mediated, safeguarding-reviewed, and human-approved.
safetyNote: Cross-community cohorts must be conflict-sensitive, partner-mediated, safeguarding-reviewed, and human-approved.
